clue.text: Teepee with heraldic metal on each part causing lethargy

parts.note: teepee sounds like the two letters T and P, which the clue treats as two parts
or is gold in heraldry, one of its two metals
teepee sounds like the two letters T and P, which the clue treats as two parts
or is gold in heraldry, one of its two metals

explanation.surface: Something about a tent decorated with gold makes one sluggish.
explanation.walkthrough: Teepee is read as the letters T P; 'on each part' tells you to put OR (heraldic gold) after each of them.
explanation.definitionFit: Torpor is a state of sluggish inactivity, a close synonym of lethargy.

clue.text: The French pray in dream for cancellation of death warrant

indicators.note: in tells you one French word sits inside the other

parts.note: the French for dream is rêve, written here without its accent; 'The French' covers this word too
the French verb for 'pray' is prier, giving prie

explanation.surface: A French prayer said in a dream for a condemned prisoner's pardon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The French' covers both verbs and nouns: the answer is built from two French words, one placed 'in' the other.
explanation.definitionFit: A reprieve cancels or postpones a sentence of execution, so it undoes a death warrant.

clue.text: Defeated by service with funny old heart, knowing a little

indicators.note: heart says the second piece forms the middle of the first

parts.note: in tennis a player beaten by an unreturnable serve is aced
quaint means oddly old-fashioned

explanation.surface: A tennis player beaten on serve, with a quirky old heart, has some acquaintance with something.
explanation.walkthrough: QUAINT becomes the heart of ACED.
explanation.definitionFit: To be acquainted with something is to have some familiarity with it, a slight knowledge.

clue.text: All or nothing?

definitions.meaning: the song says 'all you need is' this, so it can be everything
in tennis scoring a zero score is called by this word

explanation.definitionFit: Love can be everything to a lover, and it is also the tennis term for a score of zero.

clue.text: Don't talk to revolutionary: turn up nose about him to create a shield

indicators.note: about means the reversed word goes around the other pieces
in a down clue turning up reads the word from the bottom, i.e. backwards

parts.note: taken as written
to cut someone is to ignore them deliberately
Che Guevara is the stock crossword revolutionary

explanation.surface: Advice to snub a radical and look down on him, building a protective shield.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn up' reverses NOSE to ESON, which goes 'about' CUT and CHE.
explanation.definitionFit: An escutcheon is the shield on which a coat of arms is displayed.

clue.text: Clothes that give a lift to boast

indicators.note: in a down clue lifting a word means reading it upwards, so backwards

parts.note: to brag is to boast

explanation.surface: Clothes that make a show-off feel grander.
explanation.definitionFit: Garb is clothing, especially of a distinctive kind.

clue.text: Cereal makes you finally smile

indicators.note: makes signals the letters are formed into something new
finally takes only the last letter of the word you

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A breakfast cereal that puts a smile on your face at last.
explanation.definitionFit: Muesli is a breakfast cereal of oats, nuts and dried fruit.

clue.text: End of school time in America

parts.note: a school year is divided into terms
taken as written
US is the United States

explanation.surface: The end of the school term somewhere in the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: A terminus is the end point, as of a railway or bus line.

clue.text: Ocean turns to sea, being absent from the puzzle

indicators.note: turns signals the word Ocean is rearranged

parts.note: the anagram fodder
the Ross Sea lies off Antarctica

explanation.surface: An ocean becoming a sea, which seems missing from this crossword.
explanation.walkthrough: This clue is itself 9 across; the grid has no clue numbered 1 across, so that entry is absent from the puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: The grid's first across light is numbered 9, so a light labelled with the number one is missing here.

clue.text: Has your common expression been a heraldic colour?

indicators.note: a common, dropped-aitch pronunciation says the words as 'as yer'

parts.note: spoken carelessly, without the h, these words run together

explanation.surface: Asking whether your everyday phrase has been a coat-of-arms colour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'common expression' signals a sound-alike: 'has your' said without its H.
explanation.definitionFit: Azure is the heraldic term for blue.

clue.text: Heraldic colour, nearly clean, then clean

indicators.note: nearly drops the last letter of the first synonym

parts.note: pure means clean, untainted
pure again, in full this time

explanation.surface: A coat-of-arms colour that is almost spotless, then spotless.
explanation.definitionFit: Purpure is the heraldic name for purple.

clue.text: Set mob on us to tell our secrets

indicators.note: set as in arrange means the letters are rearranged

parts.note: part of the fodder
part of the fodder
part of the fodder

explanation.surface: Unleash the crowd on us so that we confess everything.
explanation.definitionFit: To unbosom is to disclose one's thoughts or secrets, to unburden oneself.

clue.text: A duty here, maybe, to regret what seemed a good idea at the time

definitions.text: regret what seemed a good idea at the time

indicators.note: maybe suggests the letters could be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: An obligation that one later wishes one had never taken on.
explanation.definitionFit: To rue a particular time is an idiom for bitterly regretting an action taken then.

clue.text: Going backwards on the question of surrender

parts.note: in re is Latin for in the matter of, concerning
cession is the formal ceding of territory or rights

explanation.surface: Retreating on the matter of giving in.
explanation.definitionFit: An economy in recession is shrinking, so it is moving backwards.

clue.text: Conductor's elevated role with old car

parts.note: Sir Simon Rattle is a famous British orchestral conductor

indicators.note: in a down clue elevated means written upwards, so backwards

parts.note: a part is a role in a play

explanation.surface: An orchestral conductor taking a lofty role in an old vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A rattletrap is a rickety old vehicle, a banger.

clue.text: Tigger's inn provides what makes finger impressive

indicators.note: provides suggests the letters are made over into something else

explanation.surface: A pub run by the bouncy tiger of Winnie-the-Pooh supplies jewellery.
explanation.walkthrough: The S of Tigger's counts as a letter here.
explanation.definitionFit: A signet ring is pressed into wax to leave a seal, so the finger wearing it can make an impression.

clue.text: Prevent occurrence of a heraldic colour

parts.note: vert is heraldic green

explanation.surface: Stopping a coat-of-arms colour from appearing.
explanation.definitionFit: To avert something is to ward it off so it does not happen.

clue.text: Well off when opening to the north is a foot in circumference

indicators.note: in circumference means the first pieces wrap around the others

parts.note: a flue is an opening or duct for smoke
N is the abbreviation for north

explanation.surface: A rich person's chimney vent faces north and measures a foot around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when' and 'is' are link words; 'in circumference' means the first pair wraps round the second.
explanation.definitionFit: Affluent means wealthy, comfortably well-to-do.

clue.text: See 13
Adhesives slightly adjusted to form heraldic colour

indicators.note: a small adjustment means the letters are rearranged a little

parts.note: glues are adhesives

explanation.surface: Glues rearranged a bit to make a coat-of-arms colour.
explanation.walkthrough: Swap the L and U of GLUES.
explanation.definitionFit: Gules is the heraldic name for red.

clue.text: Title assigning traditional gender to vessel

parts.note: ships are traditionally called she, so a vessel is given the female title lady
a ship is a vessel

explanation.surface: Calling a boat 'she', as sailors always have.
explanation.walkthrough: 'assigning ... to' joins the pieces: a lady ship is a vessel given its customary female gender.
explanation.definitionFit: Ladyship is the form of address for a woman of noble rank, as in 'Her Ladyship'.

clue.text: European woman a fool about the European dishonesty

parts.note: Frau is German for a wife or woman

indicators.note: about means the fool goes around the article

parts.note: a dunce is a fool
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A Continental woman fooling around with a European, a dishonest business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the European' is the French definite article, a European word for 'the'; 'about' puts it inside the fool.
explanation.definitionFit: Fraudulence is the quality of being fraudulent, i.e. deceit.

clue.text: Dress of one on the wagon leading to anger

parts.note: a means one
TT means teetotal, off the drink
ire is anger

explanation.surface: A teetotaller's outfit leading to fury.
explanation.definitionFit: Attire is clothing, so a dress or outfit is one's attire.

clue.text: See 13
Significant sort of service for solvers at sultanate

parts.note: ye is the old word for you, the solvers being addressed
Oman is a sultanate in Arabia

explanation.surface: Important work for crossword solvers in an Arabian state.
explanation.walkthrough: Yeoman service is an idiom for good, valuable work.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase yeoman service describes useful, loyal help, so the first word stands for that kind of service.

clue.text: Repressed and disapproving, or elevated and drunk

parts.note: up means raised
tight is slang for drunk

explanation.surface: Someone stiff and prudish, or else high and sloshed.
explanation.definitionFit: Uptight describes someone tense, inhibited and prudish.

clue.text: Permit Israeli boy's short time with luxury sports car

parts.note: to grant is to permit
Uri is a Hebrew boy's name, with its possessive S kept
mo is short for moment

explanation.surface: Allowing a lad from Israel a quick spin in a flashy car.
explanation.definitionFit: A gran turismo, or GT, is a high-performance touring car built for comfort at speed.

clue.text: See 26
Country to leave?

parts.note: go means leave

explanation.surface: Asking whether a nation is ready to depart.
explanation.definitionFit: Togo is a country in West Africa.

clue.text: Major opera?

parts.note: ... Major was the wife of British Prime Minister John Major, and Bellini wrote an opera of that title

explanation.definitionFit: Bellini's opera shares its title with the first name of John Major's wife, so it could be called the Major opera.

clue.text: Heraldic metal in a country

parts.note: argent is silver in heraldry

explanation.surface: Silver found in a South American nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Argentina is a country in South America, its name itself linked to silver.
